name: Mary Christiansen
source:
Mary is the wife of [url=/c64151]Joseph[/url] and the mother of [url=/c76983]Chris[/url], [url=/c76989]Christian[/url], [url=/c76990]Christie[/url], and Crish.

Mary makes several appearances throughout the game, usually either intoxicated or behaving inappropriately. She appears neglectful towards her children and is outright hostile towards Joseph, at one point telling the player he is better at "pretending to be happy" in their marriage than she is.

Mary is friends with [url=/c64153]Robert[/url] and spends most evenings at the bar with him. [spoiler]Despite her penchant for hanging around other men, the player can learn from Robert as well as Neil the bartender at Jim and Kim's that Mary does not engage in extramarital affairs. If the player has not been on a second date with Joseph, there will be an interlude where they can walk Mary home from the bar. Mary will apologize for her abrasive nature and any hurt feelings as a result.

However, if the player does pursue a romance with her husband, Mary will confront them about it at Jim's and Kim's. She will snidely comment that the player is "not Joseph's type", alluding to how Joseph had once cheated on her with Robert. This will happen even if the player chooses a different dad for their third date.[/spoiler]

[From the [url=https://dreamdaddy.fandom.com/wiki/Mary]Wiki[/url].]
